latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of wavespeed-wan-26 – Generate videos using Alibaba's Wan 2.6 model via WaveSpeed AI.

- Supports text-to-video and image-to-video generation, up to 15 seconds per video, 720p or 1080p.
- Includes audio-guided generation, prompt expansion, multi-shot mode, and configurable seeds.
- API covers prompt, negative prompt, size/resolution, duration, shot type, and more.
- Example code and advanced usage provided for both JavaScript and custom clients.
- Security, pricing, and prompt writing tips included.
